'''Echo Twelve''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

During the [[Battle at TFP-9]], the enemies were reinforced by unknown  [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which destroyed Echo Twelve, as [[Rhys Dallows]] later reported.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
